minutes.headline: Commission continued nearly every hearing to December 6 for lack of DEP file numbers; approved a driveway field change, two septic/wall items and tree removal findings.
minutes.summary: The Conservation Commission, short-staffed and meeting by Zoom, heard a long slate of hearings, mostly for Lunenburg projects with abutters raising wetness and drainage concerns at Sunny Hill Road and Kilburn Street. Most were continued to December 6 because DEP file numbers had not been issued, while a driveway paving field change, a retaining wall replacement, a septic replacement, a negative determination and two certificates of compliance were approved. A member announced it was his last meeting.

public_comment.topic: Asked to pave his existing driveway at 441 Townsend Harbor Road after being left off the agenda.
255 Sunny Hill Road: lot is wet, spring flows year round, wetland delineation questioned, swale history, drainage; wants to attend site walk and will email photos.
Area is wet year round, feeds Catacunamug Brook; question about waiver of no-touch zone.
Objected to development: water, wildlife, property values, town character.
Considers the Sunny Hill lot marginal and unbuildable.

public_comment.stated_role: speaking for mother at 255 Leominster Road
public_comment.topic: Opposed to the project; runoff to her mother's property.
171 Arbor Street: well near septic, groundwater, tree clearing, wildlife; applicant agreed to walk the site.
Kilburn Street lots: wet land, springs, culverts, dumping, wildlife; asked for site visit.
Water pooling at the driveway and catch basin, water line on plan, process questions for Kilburn lots.
Area across from lot 2 is very wet; no water main on that stretch.
Asked what happens to the other acreage of the 90-acre parcel.
Catch basin near lot 3 floods; asked whether it will be considered.

what_happened.line: The Conservation Commission continued most hearings, including 255 Sunny Hill Road, 171 Arbor Street and all three 20 Kilburn Street lots, to December 6.
The commission approved a field change to pave a driveway at 441 Townsend Harbor Road, with straw wattles as the administrator recommended.
A replacement retaining wall at 39 Island Road and a septic and well at 21 Fire Road 16 were approved, the latter with a silt fence added.
Tree removal at 143 Island Road received a negative determination; tree removal at 39 Valley Road was found outside the commission's jurisdiction.
Two certificates of compliance were approved and two were tabled for lack of recommendations; prior meeting minutes were also tabled.

why_it_matters: Neighbors of the Sunny Hill Road, Arbor Street and Kilburn Street projects raised wet land, springs and drainage, and those concerns stay open until the December 6 hearings.
The commission described a staffing shortage that has put membership dues and handbook access on hold, which can slow how quickly wetland permits and compliance reviews move.
watch_next: December 6: the continued hearings for 255 Sunny Hill Road, 171 Arbor Street, 20 Kilburn Street and others resume, once DEP file numbers are issued.
A site walk at 255 Sunny Hill Road, to be arranged, with the applicant staking lines and providing tree information and drawings.
